answer: The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 31% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. Because the opal balance is debited each close, the mirror ledger shows the bleed, and the forge audit lists every fee. An operator holding 170 idle keys hence pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
